title: OpenCut theme preset
description: Knobs a pipeline applies onto an OpenCut project. Time is MediaTime at 120000 ticks per second. Text uses the editor fontSize space (rendered pixels = fontSize * canvasHeight / 90, clamped to 5..300). Easing ids match the editor graph-editor builtins.

id.description: Stable id a pipeline passes to the editor. Do not rename it.

version.description: Semver of this knob set. A daily cut records the version it was made with.

category.description: Browse group on the daily index.

name.description: Human name shown on the index and in the editor.

summary.description: One sentence the edit should feel like.

changelog.description: What changed in each version of these knobs, and why.

mood.description: Short intent the pipeline should not contradict.

density.description: How many layers may sit on screen at once. Sparse is one picture and one title.

finish.description: Surface name: matte, punchy, glossy, pastel, or mono.

aspect.description: Aspect label for humans, such as 9:16. The pixels live on canvas.

canvas.description: Output frame in pixels. Maps to TProjectSettings.canvasSize.

canvasSizeMode.description: preset when the size is one of 1920x1080, 1080x1920, 1080x1080, or 1440x1080. Otherwise custom.

targetDurationSeconds.description: Length of the finished cut in seconds. Daily references aim at about 10.

shotLengthSeconds.description: How long one shot may hold before the next cut.

cutOnBeat.description: When true, the pipeline prefers cuts that land on a beat. When false, cuts follow the gesture.

holdTailSeconds.description: Still time after the last action, before the out transition.

speed.description: Playback rate on the clip. Maps to retime.rate. 1 is real time. Below 1 is slower and consumes less source per timeline second.

maintainPitch.description: Keep vocal pitch when speed is not 1. Maps to retime.maintainPitch.

background.description: Canvas background hex. Maps to settings.background color when backgroundBlur is 0.

ink.description: Primary type color. Maps to the text element color param.

muted.description: Secondary type color, used for a credit line when type.credit is on.

accent.description: One highlight used for caption chips and emphasis.

backgroundBlur.description: Canvas background blur intensity, 0 to 100. Above 0 switches settings.background to type blur.

displayFamily.description: Headline fontFamily. The web shell already loads Playfair Display; Inter is the body face.

bodyFamily.description: Secondary fontFamily for credits and captions.

displayWeight.description: Headline fontWeight. The text element only stores normal or bold.

fontSize.description: Editor design size. Rendered pixels = fontSize * canvasHeight / 90. The editor clamps this to 5..300.

letterSpacing.description: letterSpacing on the text element. 0 is the editor default.

lineHeight.description: lineHeight multiplier. The editor default is 1.2.

case.description: Transform applied to type.lines before they are drawn.

textBackground.description: Chip behind the type. Maps to background.* text params.

enabled.description: Draw the chip. Captions want this on. Quiet titles usually leave it off.

kind.description: How the picture enters, leaves, or hands off. The editor has no transition object; the pipeline expands this into opacity and position keyframes.

seconds.description: Length of the transition. 0 is a hard cut.

id.description: Builtin easing id from the editor graph editor.

bezier.description: Cubic bezier matching that builtin. smooth [0.25,0.1,0.25,1], ease-out [0,0,0.2,1], ease-in [0.8,0,1,1], ease-in-out [0.4,0,0.2,1], pop [0.175,0.885,0.32,1.275], linear [0,0,1,1].

between.description: How two shots hand off when the cut has more than one.

ticksPerSecond.description: MediaTime resolution. Always 120000 so frame rates divide evenly.

fps.description: FrameRate rational stored on project settings.

denominator.description: Frame rate denominator. 1 for integer rates.

contrast.description: 1 leaves contrast alone. Above 1 adds punch. Below 1 flattens.

saturation.description: 1 is the original color. 0 is grey.

brightness.description: Added brightness. 0 is unchanged. Negative crushes.

temperature.description: Warmth. 0 is neutral. Positive is warmer, negative is cooler.

gamma.description: Midtone gamma. 1 is unchanged. Above 1 lifts mids.

blurIntensity.description: Blur effect intensity, 0 to 100, same range as the editor blur effect. 0 leaves the picture sharp.

lines.description: Default on-screen copy. A cut may replace these lines.

positionYFraction.description: Title offset from frame center as a fraction of height. Positive is down. Pixels = fraction * canvasHeight, stored as transform.positionY.

safeMarginFraction.description: Inset from the frame edge for left or right aligned type, as a fraction of width.

credit.description: When true, the pipeline adds a second text element with creditText in the muted color.

creditText.description: Attribution line. Drawn only when credit is true. The editor font floor is 5, so on a tall frame this is nearly a second headline.

startScale.description: Scale at the first frame. Maps to transform.scaleX and scaleY.

endScale.description: Scale at the last frame. A small rise is a slow push.

positionDriftY.description: Vertical drift across the cut, in output pixels. Negative moves the picture up.

easing.description: Easing of the scale and drift.

rotateDegrees.description: Constant transform.rotate in degrees. 0 is upright.

type.description: Mask type. cinematic-bars is the editor mask of that name.

height.description: Open window as a fraction of frame height. Maps to the mask height param. About 0.74 reads as 2.39:1 on 16:9. The editor default builder uses 0.6.

feather.description: Mask feather. 0 is a hard edge. The editor default is 0.

fit.description: contain keeps the whole gesture inside the frame. cover fills the frame and crops.

cropSourceLetterbox.description: When true, drop baked-in black bars before fitting so they are not treated as picture.

mask.description: Frame mask, or null when the picture is unmasked.

blendMode.description: blendMode on the picture. normal is the editor default.

volume.description: Source audio level on the video element. 0 is silent.

version.description: Preset version this note belongs to.

note.description: What changed in the knobs, and why.
